title: Solution Explorer
description: Learn how to navigate and manage your .NET solution using the enhanced Solution Explorer.

steps.title: Opening the Solution Explorer
steps.description:
The Solution Explorer is automatically activated when opening a workspace with a .NET solution (.sln) file. You can find it in the Activity Bar on the left side of VS Code.

If it's not visible, you can click on the C# icon in the Activity Bar to open it.

media.altText: Solution Explorer view showing a .NET solution structure

steps.title: Understanding the Solution Structure
steps.description:
The Solution Explorer shows a tree view of your solution with all projects and files:

- **Solution**: The root node that contains all projects
- **Projects**: Individual .NET projects in your solution
- **Solution Folders**: Used to organize projects (not actual file system folders)
- **References**: References to assemblies and NuGet packages
- **Files & Folders**: All source files organized by their physical structure

media.altText: Solution Explorer showing the solution structure with projects and files

steps.title: Using the Context Menu
steps.description:
Right-click on any item in the Solution Explorer to access a context-sensitive menu with various actions:

- **Add**: Create new files, classes, or folders
- **Build/Rebuild/Clean**: Manage project build operations
- **NuGet**: Manage NuGet packages for the project
- **User Secrets**: Manage configuration secrets
- **Cut/Copy/Paste/Rename/Delete**: Manage files and folders

Many operations typically found in Visual Studio are available directly in the context menu.

media.altText: Context menu showing various actions available for a project

steps.title: Recent Solutions
steps.description:
The Solution Explorer includes a **Recent Solutions** panel that tracks your previously opened solutions.

- **Pin solutions**: Click the pin icon to keep important solutions at the top
- **Open in new window**: Click the external link icon to open a solution in a new window
- **Clear list**: Use the view menu to clear unpinned or all solutions

media.altText: Recent Solutions panel showing pinned and recent solutions

steps.title: Sync with Editor
steps.description:
The Solution Explorer automatically highlights the file you're currently editing. This behavior can be customized in the settings:

1. **Track Active File**: Automatically reveal the current file (enabled by default)
2. **Collapse Other Paths**: Collapse other expanded paths when tracking the active file

You can also manually reveal the current file using the command **Reveal Current File in Solution Explorer** (Shift+Alt+L).

media.altText: Solution Explorer with a file highlighted that matches the active editor
